<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 127.0997 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈126.092 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈8 % M+1) indicates about eight carbon atoms. The formula C₈H₁₄O has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 126.104 Da, which is the closest match (≈95 ppm error) and fits the observed isotopic distribution. Therefore the molecular formula is C₈H₁₄O.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O</final_answer>
